latest_release.name: Android 1.15
latest_release.body:
**[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)** ## English ### New features - **Added Settings > Network** — Tailscale (one-tap sign-in), upstream proxies (HTTP or SOCKS5) and per-scope routes for model requests, MCP, the shell, WebViews and backups, with Network Diagnostics and "Restore Direct Connections". Every request the app makes follows them, and each provider's page has its own Network row. In the shell, programs that ignore proxy variables (ssh, nc, database clients) follow the routes too, for TCP, UDP and DNS, and tailnet names (MagicDNS, short names like "nas") resolve there. Small pills under the home title show whether Tailscale and the proxy are up. - **Added in-app updates with Stable and Beta channels** — Minis checks for a new version when you open it (switch it off in About), shows a dot on Settings › About when one is waiting, lets you skip a version, and verifies the download before it installs. Choose Beta in About › Update channel to get test builds. - **Added questions from the assistant** — the assistant can ask on an in-chat card (options, confirmation, multi-question wizard) and waits for your answer. In the background the question arrives as a notification you can answer in place, and a pending question can still be answered after the app restarts. - **Added provider quota & balance** — remaining balance or subscription usage on the provider page, in the model picker and Model Groups, and in the composer. Supports DeepSeek, Moonshot, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, Kimi Code, relay services (Sub2API / New API / OpenAI-style) and Claude / ChatGPT subscriptions. - **Added a Usage page** — Today / 7 days / 30 days / All, with totals, a stacked trend chart and a drill-down by provider and model. - **Improved long agent runs** — old reasoning, large tool outputs and old steps are trimmed a little at a time before a summary is needed, so a long task stays within the context window. The turn limit per run is now 500 (was 200). - **Added sub agent cards** — they show the task, its tool calls and latest output, with Steer and Stop. Up to 6 chats, and 3 sub agents per chat, can run at once. - **Improved scheduled tasks** — a chat with a scheduled follow-up stays active between runs; a pill under the chat title counts down in the last minute before a run, and its long-press menu has "Run now". A timed task fires on time while Minis is open. - **Added Search in Chat** — find text in the open chat from the "…" menu, a long-press or a text selection, with matches highlighted. Session search groups results by folder and matches any of several keywords. - **Added Share Chat…** — share any messages as one long image or a PDF with searchable text. - **Improved groups on the home screen** — a group's avatar is a tile of its newest chats, a comet runs round it while one of them is working, and an unread reply shows a red dot on its chat and on the group. - **Added folding of consecutive tool calls** into one "Ran N tools" row that opens on tap (on by default; Settings › Appearance › Tool Calls). - **Added Stop choices** — "Stop Current Tool Only / Stop All" when sub agents or scheduled tasks are running; long-press the stop button to choose whether it confirms first. - **Added a "Show current model" button** to the model picker that jumps to the chat's group or model in a long list. Hidden models are collected in a "Hidden models (N)" group, and any model can be deleted from its long-press menu. - Added browser sign-in (OAuth) for remote MCP servers, and search and Enable All / Disable All in the in-chat MCP sheet. - Added editing of saved backup servers, and ZIP64 for backups over 4 GB or 65,535 files. - Also added: turning environment variables off; Codex speed tiers and GPT-6.1 Sol; a per-provider response timeout for slow local models; read-aloud volume up to 200%; "Show full thinking"; `
` and simple HTML in Markdown; minis-config for Network and more settings; Italian, Dutch, Hungarian, Czech and Persian. ### Fixes - Fixed c
